correctness.rationale: On the affine chart a=1 the inverse polynomial coordinate change yields the exact normal form Δ=v(v−c²)²−c³u². The complete Tjurina ideal (Δ and all differentials) has generators c²w,cvw,c³u,vw², with w=v−c². Since (c,v)^3:w=(c,v)^2, it equals (c,v)^3∩(u,w). The GL2-invariant affine cover proves equality of projective ideal sheaves; the two primary ideals are smooth-locus powers / reduced prime ideals. Exact sympy code in verify.py checks the local identities and intersection. Degree 16 follows from the smooth quadric, projected Veronese, and generic lengths 6 and 1. value.rationale: The discriminant and its (3,1)/(2,2) singular partition strata are canonical objects; their *nonreduced* singular structure changes substantially in bad characteristic. The smooth triple-root support falls in degree from 6 to 2 while its infinitesimal length rises from 2 to 6, preserving degree 16. The full cubic ideal-power decomposition identifies intrinsic scheme structure at the quadruple-root intersection rather than merely numerical or support data, making this a motivated structural boundary case.
